_about: A car park's asphalt across loads in one game (seen while checking GitHub issue #6: a standard car park rebuilt after the game's second load showed grass under its stalls). Built, then the city is saved and loaded back twice in this game, then edited and built again; a picture after each. Send with: powershell -File tools/suite/Send-Suite.ps1 -File suite/scenarios/reload-surfaces.json -Fresh -Who <you>
